architecture.editorial_thesis: In 2026-W38 the frontier went vertical and verifiable: OpenAI configured Astra into Law with a 230M-URL index and Trusted Access governance; Google shipped a native speech-to-speech Live line; Anthropic opened biology access under verification (LSVP), published its R&D pace metrics, and instantiated pacing with a $1B+ Accenture embedded-evaluation deal following Amodei's pacing essay; TypeSafe launched non-generative System One decisions with Jev; Cognition productized codebase investigation (Code Scans); and image went production (Character.ai's open-lineage CAI-Image family, PixAI Tsubaki.3 GA) — with DeepSeek's Sep-14 Pro-to-Flash routing cutover held as serving context and GLM-5.5 disposed as rumor.
